{{Top|leg}}
'''Hub 3''' was one of the districts that made up [[Kaas City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It notably hosted the office of the [[Ministry of Logistics]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hub 3 and the other districts of Kaas City were mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], in the form of inscriptions on a map kiosk.
